note:
The stage driver's head, composited over the coach he is baked into. Doc 43 part two and Q55. He is not a mover: only 55% of him separates, and below 27% of the assembly he is fused into the seat, footboard and reins -- so the head swaps and the body holds, the same shape as Thad's talk.

SOURCE reference/casting/driver-head-{neutral,speaking,looking-down}.png, 786x1140 each on one shared canvas. Keyed and despilled here: looking-down arrived as RGB with the magenta still in it -- 279,697 opaque magenta pixels, 31.2% of its canvas -- and would have drawn a slab across a third of the coach on the state that is up while Thad speaks.

rect_space IS body-frame AND THAT IS NOT WHAT THAD'S TALK DIRECTORIES DO. Thad's overlay_rect is measured in the ORIGINAL pre-downsample canvas -- thad-talk-right says [383,207,64,68] against a body PNG only 390 wide -- and the conversion factor lives nowhere. These frames are authored at final resolution, so the rect is in the coach body frame's own 956x389 pixels and the PNG is exactly the rect. The field says which, because two conventions that look identical is how the next person gets it wrong.

THE RECT WAS MEASURED, TWICE, BY METHODS THAT DO NOT SHARE AN ASSUMPTION. Normalised cross-correlation over an unconstrained search (widths 40-170, x 340-580, y -30-150) peaks at 54x78 at x408 y12, with the top eight inside x404-410 y8-14. A masked absolute-difference search over a tight window minimises at 55x80 at x407 y11, and the minimum is sharp: +/-2px in either axis costs 40-50%, +/-4px of width costs 55%. The origin also agrees with the project owner's own measurement of the separable region, x738 y18 of the 1728-wide body scaled by 956/1728 = x408.3 y9.96.

THE SIZE IS NOT THE SEPARABLE REGION'S SIZE. That region is 158x172 in the source, 87x95 shown; this portrait is 55x80. The region is the area of the coach that MAY be redrawn and the head occupies its upper-left -- the portrait's aspect is 0.689 and the region's is 0.919, so they were never the same rectangle. Scaled to 87 wide the man comes out about 1.6x the driver already sitting there and you get two drivers, the original's hat behind the new one.

CONFIRMED AGAINST THE ART, NOT BY EYE. The coach's own hat brim is 53px wide at y28, x409-461. The overlay's brim at this rect is 52px at y28, x410-461. Reading the composite by eye said it was still too big; measuring said it lands within one pixel. R5b2 -- small pixel-art thumbnails are not evidence about geometry either.
